Its primary functionality involves querying and resetting user sessions on local or remote servers using the WinStation API family (e.g., WinStationOpenServerW, WinStationGetAllSessionsW, WinStationReset). It also utilizes ExitWindowsEx with the EWX_LOGOFF flag to perform user logoffs. The code structure, including command-line parsing for the '/server' flag and the use of utildll.dll for localized resource strings, is consistent with standard Windows administrative tools.
